caption: The drawing shows a rectangular window with two panes of glass, one above the other separated by a horizontal wooden bar. The window frame is made up of reddish-brown wood. The top and bottom horizontal sections of the frame each contain a short cylindrical decorative element; both are black with yellow floral motifs and framed by the same reddish-brown wood. The vertical sides of the window are flanked by elongated, black cylindrical columns that run most of the height of the window. These columns also feature yellow floral decorations. The background is plain and off-white, and there is a faint signature, "R. Marubelli," in the lower right corner. The glass panes show faint reflections, illustrated by diagonal streaks of gray.
title: Wall Mirror
